comment: Looper for stock firmware. The footswitch (the effect's on/off) is the looper's button: press = record / play / overdub, double press = stop, double press when stopped = clear. The loop keeps playing whether the effect shows on or off. Mono loop (L+R), 12-bit block float, two buffers for undo. Long (experimental, MS-70CDR 2.10 only) adds 2.7 MB of RAM that MIDISTOMP's RAM test found unused. Screen: state, time and the loop's waveform with a playhead (zvis, MS-70CDR 2.10). Quantize (0.02): Tempo (BPM) and Beats per bar set before recording snap the loop to whole bars; Click adds a metronome to the output (accent on the bar).

params.name: Fade
params.comment: How much of the loop stays on each overdub lap (100 = all, lower = older layers fade).

params.name: Undo
params.comment: Flip it either way to undo the last overdub; flip again to redo.

params.name: Long
params.comment: 1 = experimental long loops in extra RAM (MS-70CDR 2.10, not with MIDISTOMP). Takes effect when the looper is empty.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM for quantize and the click, 40-250 (lower values play 40). Taken when recording starts.

params.name: Beats
params.comment: Beats per bar. 0 = Off (free length); 1 = snap to beats; 2-12 = snap to bars of that many beats. Taken when recording starts.

params.name: Click
params.comment: Metronome level (0 = silent), only with Beats set. Accent on each bar. In the output only, never recorded.
